sources_summary: Pew/ARDA 2000 and 2010 U.S. Religion Census (Church self-report).
Deseret News Church Almanac figures (2002-2009), via cumorah.com's LDS Church growth archive and rickety.us.

Church newsroom country page (2012-2025), via Wikipedia's "United States membership statistics (LDS Church)" compiled table: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_membership_statistics_(LDS_Church)
method: This is a compiled timeline, not one survey's microdata - each point is a separately cited Church-reported (or Church-published round estimate) figure. 2001, 2003, 2005, 2007, and 2011 have no findable U.S.-only total in any source checked and are linearly interpolated between their nearest real neighbors; every other year is a real reported figure. See each year's own `status` (reported/rounded/interpolated) and `source`.

2000.source: 2000 U.S. Religion Census (Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies), LDS Church self-report.

2001.source: Linearly interpolated between the 2000 and 2002 figures - no U.S.-only total for 2001 was found in any available source.

2002.source: Deseret News Church Almanac figure, as compiled by cumorah.com's LDS Church growth archive; known only to the nearest 10,000.

2003.source: Linearly interpolated between the 2002 and 2004 figures - no U.S.-only total for 2003 was found in any available source.

2004.source: Deseret News Church Almanac figure, as compiled by cumorah.com; known only to the nearest 10,000.

2005.source: Linearly interpolated between the 2004 and 2006 figures - no U.S.-only total for 2005 was found in any available source.

2006.source: Deseret News Church Almanac figure, as compiled by cumorah.com; known only to the nearest 10,000.

2007.source: Linearly interpolated between the 2006 and 2008 figures - no U.S.-only total for 2007 was found in any available source.

2008.source: Deseret News Church Almanac figure, as compiled by cumorah.com; known only to the nearest 10,000.

2009.source: Deseret News 2011 Church Almanac, as compiled by rickety.us.

2010.source: 2010 U.S. Religion Census (Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies), LDS Church self-report.

2011.source: Linearly interpolated between the 2010 and 2012 figures - no U.S.-only total for 2011 was found in any available source.

2020.note: Published as a round number; the Church did not release an exact 2020 total.
